ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Blind: Without his goggles, Doctor Mid-Nite is completely blind, except in pitch blackness. Portsmouth Medical Clinic: Doctor Mid-Nite runs a community clinic with assistants who help him in his adventures. But the staff and the clients of the clinic have also become targets for his enemies.
